name: Nordwalde (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with five vertical stripes of green and white, charged at the top of the middle green stripe with the municipal arms of Nordwalde (three trees on green), beneath a green and white chequy strip at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Nordwalde; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Nordwalde arms — three trees on green
